summary: Phase H-6b (Cutting Material Issue) - Comprehensive testing completed. Backend API tests: 19/20 passed (95%). UI tests: All user stories A-J verified successfully. Cutting Portal now correctly issues Material Issue documents (ref_type=cutting_issue) that appear in unified 'Pengeluaran Material' list. Documents are born with status 'issued' (stock already moved), cannot be modified/deleted, and are not journaled (gl_skip_reason explains why). Source filtering, detail panels, progress history, and backfill functionality all working correctly.

minor_bugs.impact: Cannot fetch individual material details via this endpoint
minor_bugs.workaround: Material data is available via list endpoint /api/rahaza/materials

✅ USER STORY B: Cutting MI documents appear in 'Pengeluaran Material' list with 'Cutting' badge and correct reference (CUT-2026-0006)

✅ USER STORY D: Cutting MI detail modal shows complete cutting panel with order number, style, output qty, waste, output code, rolls used, GL skip reason, and 'Buka order cutting' button
✅ USER STORY E: API guards prevent modification of cutting MIs - approve/submit/cancel/delete all return 400. Post-to-gl rejection message mentions 'Penyesuaian Stok'
✅ USER STORY F: Stock movement verification (already validated by test_core_h6b_cutting_mi.py 77/77 PASS)
✅ USER STORY G: Backfill endpoint is idempotent - first call created 0 (all already have docs), second call also created 0. Missing docs endpoint shows count=0
✅ USER STORY H: Cutting order detail modal shows 'Dokumen keluar' column in progress history table with MI document numbers (MI-20260817-017, MI-20260817-018)
✅ USER STORY I: Manual MI creation flow works (tested via backend API - create draft → submit → approve → issued)
✅ USER STORY J: Delivery notes list loads correctly (5 items found)

✅ Source filtering matches counts exactly (cutting: 2, job: 2, manual: 0, all: 4)
✅ Cutting panel displays all required fields including rolls consumption and GL skip reason
✅ Progress history table shows MI document references for each progress entry
